symbol: # notation.tsv -- the hand-authored source for the notation table.
# make_notation.py scans the body .tex files for symbols, joins them against
# this file, and writes notation_table.tex. A symbol used in the body with no
# row here fails the build; a row here whose symbol is never used is dropped
# from the table with a warning.
# Columns are TAB separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#   symbol       As written in the body, without the surrounding $. This is
#                matched on the BASE symbol, so a row for "q" covers q_{01}
#                and q_{10}; give them separate rows only if you want separate
#                table lines, in which case write the full form.
#   group        index | variable | parameter. Sets which block of the table
#                the row lands in. Order WITHIN a block follows first use in
#                the body, so it is not specified here.
#   shape        Conformability metadata for the equation checker. Either
#                "scalar" or ROWSxCOLS, e.g. 2x1. Not printed in the table.
#   description  The table cell. May contain math and LaTeX markup.
